name: Ondřej Kolář - Proposition de résolution (ensemble du texte)
title: REPORT on the 2023 and 2024 Commission reports on Bosnia and Herzegovina
part_text:
The European Parliament sets out its position on Bosnia and Herzegovina's path to joining the European Union. It supports membership but says reforms have stalled. It asks the country's leaders to stop secessionist moves and divisive talk, and to fight corruption and organised crime. It calls on the European Union to sanction destabilising figures, especially Milorad Dodik, and to counter Russian and Chinese interference. It also asks for better rule of law, media freedom, minority rights and environmental protection. This is an opinion, not a law.

- The Parliament asks the European Union to sanction Milorad Dodik and other destabilising figures; member states decide.
- Bosnia and Herzegovina must meet reform conditions before talks advance; its leaders and institutions are affected.
- The Parliament calls for an end to secessionist laws and foreign interference; the European Commission and European Union countries are urged to act.
